messages:
Priya: Quick AV + interviewer checklist for tomorrow's 10:00am PT candidate (IC role). Please skim — just a few asks.

Elena: Thanks — can you call out the Zoom link and room? I'm coming from a different office.

Priya: Zoom link is in the invite, but copying here too: https://company.zoom.us/j/1234567890. Room A/V laptop will be on a cart near 4th floor lobby.

Samir: For scoring — are we using the new condensed rubric? I only skimmed it. Any anchor examples?

Maya_K: Yes, use the condensed rubric v2 (one-page). Quick anchors:
- 4 = strong: clear system design, tradeoffs, tests, and performance tradeoffs considered.
- 3 = solid: good approach, missed one key edge-case or did not fully justify perf tradeoffs.
- 2 = needs work: multiple gaps or major architecture concerns.
- 1 = not ready.
Aim to add one sentence justification per score.

Priya: Re: anchors — here's a tiny template you can paste into the debrief to speed things up: 
```
Score: 3
Why: Good overall design, missed caching detail which impacts latency under load
Follow-up question: Ask about stateful vs stateless alternatives in next call
```

Elena: Nice. Also candidate requested 1:1 captioning — can we arrange live captions in Zoom?

recruiting-bot: @Priya — accommodation request for candidate ID 4201: live captions approved. Please enable live transcriptions in Zoom.

Priya: Got it, enabling auto-transcription and I'll have an iPad with captions visible. Thanks @recruiting-bot.

Samir: Quick logistics: start at :10 (10:10 local buffer) ok? I might be 3-4 mins late.

Priya: Start at :10 to give buffer. If you're >5 mins late, please add a note in the debrief and we can reschedule the async feedback window to +24h.

calendar-bot: Event created: "IC Interview — System Design" 2026-04-02 10:00 PT. Attendees: Priya, Elena, Samir, Maya_K.

Priya: Last ask — please fill the debrief doc within 2 hours of the interview. Link: https://docs.redwood.com/debriefs/ic-system-design. Use the template header so hiring manager can triage quickly. :thumbsup:

Elena: Will do. Thanks for the heads-up.

Samir: Copy. I'll bring the anchor examples.

Maya_K: I'll paste the condensed rubric into the invite description and call out the scoring anchors.

Priya: Perfect — thanks everyone. If any last-minute issues ping here and I'll escalate.
